The '''Minister of the Interior''' was a position on the [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|Ruling Council]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. [[Armatan/Legends|Armatan]] held this position at some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
